widgets_values:
CONCEPT -- Krea 2 Turbo, 8 steps (22.3s measured)

LICENCE FIRST.  The Krea 2 Community License allows commercial use of
what this makes only while your company, affiliates included, earns
under $1,000,000 a year.  Past that you must stop commercial use of
the model AND its outputs until Krea grants an enterprise licence; it
makes no exception for images made earlier.  Krea can
also end the licence on 30 days' notice, and it requires content
filtering: review every image before it ships.  docs/guide/licensing.

Write sentences, not tags.  cfg is 1, so there is no negative: the
empty negative is a ConditioningZeroOut, and everything goes in the
prompt.  Change the seed in KSampler to reroll.

ONE TAKE AT A TIME on a 16 GB card.  The int8 weights load whole
and leave little room: 864x1152 peaked at 15,786 MiB of 16,066, and
1104x1472, or a batch of two, ran out of memory (2026-10-10).  Keep
to about a megapixel: 864x1152 for a figure, 1024x1024 for a prop.

Needs:  scripts/fetch_models.py --download --group krea2

---

Krea 2 Turbo, Krea's 12B open-weights text-to-image model,
distilled to 8 steps. LICENCE, read before shipping anything it
makes: the Krea 2 Community License Agreement v.1 (2026-06-22)
allows commercial use of the model and of its Outputs 'only if
you (including all affiliated entities under common ownership or
control) have total company-wide annual revenue of less than one
million United States dollars', and past that 'you must
immediately cease Commercial Use and contact Krea'. Krea may end
it 'for any reason upon thirty (30) days' prior written or
electronic notice', and section 4.2 requires 'reasonable and
appropriate Content Filter measures'. See
docs/guide/licensing.md. The settings are Comfy-Org's template
image_krea2_turbo_t2i_int8 (workflow_templates commit 3e50a92,
read 2026-10-10): the int8 ConvRot weights, the Qwen3-VL 4B
encoder on CLIPLoader type krea2, the same qwen_image_vae as the
Qwen graphs, 8 steps, cfg 1, euler, simple, and an empty
negative from ConditioningZeroOut. cfg 1 means no classifier-
free guidance, so everything goes in the prompt. The template's
prompt enhancer, a TextGenerate on the same encoder, is left
out. 864x1152 is 3:4, so a figure stays head to toe and
img2video_wan22's 480x640 keeps its shape, at the pixel count of
the template's 1024x1024. Run on the reference 16 GB card on
2026-10-10, in image 0.1.11: 864x1152 took 22.3 s on ComfyUI's
clock (8 steps at 2.43 s each) with VRAM peaking at 15,786 MiB
of 16,066 (nvidia-smi every 0.5 s); 1024x1024 took 27.9 s, peak
15,678 MiB. The int8 weights load whole onto the card (12,867 MB
in the server log), which leaves little for activations:
1104x1472, the Qwen concept size, and a batch of two at 864x1152
both ran out of GPU memory. Make takes one at a time. Needs the
krea2 weight group: scripts/fetch_models.py --download --group
krea2.

A weathered stone golem overgrown with moss, a single creature standing upright, the whole figure visible from head to feet in a three-quarter view. Even flat studio lighting, a plain neutral grey background and no cast shadow. Painted game asset concept art with a crisp, readable silhouette and sharp detail.
